metadata.title: State APT clusters, public attribution, recurring systems

entities.name: APT28_FancyBear
entities.notes: GRU-attributed cluster (US/UK/allied public attribution). Election interference, NATO/gov spearphish. MITRE G0007.

entities.name: APT29_CozyBear
entities.notes: SVR-attributed cluster. SolarWinds-adjacent tradecraft in public reporting. MITRE G0016.

entities.name: Sandworm
entities.notes: GRU Unit 74455 public attribution. Ukraine power, NotPetya. MITRE G0034.

entities.name: Volt_Typhoon
entities.notes: PRC-attributed living-off-the-land against US critical infrastructure (CISA).

entities.name: Salt_Typhoon
entities.notes: PRC-attributed telecom interception campaign (US public statements 2024-2025).

entities.name: APT41
entities.notes: PRC cluster mixing suspected state tasking with financially motivated ops. MITRE G0096.

entities.name: Lazarus_Group
entities.notes: DPRK-attributed. SWIFT, crypto-exchange, ransomware-adjacent. MITRE G0032.

entities.name: Equation_Group
entities.notes: Public reporting (Kaspersky, Shadow Brokers leak) associates this implant set with NSA-grade tooling. Not a courtroom finding.

entities.name: GRU
entities.notes: Russian military intelligence. Public US/UK attributions for APT28/Sandworm.

entities.name: SVR
entities.notes: Russian foreign intelligence. Public attribution for APT29.

entities.name: MSS
entities.notes: PRC Ministry of State Security. Named in multiple US indictments of APT operators.

entities.name: PLA_Strategic_Support
entities.notes: PLA cyber/electronic warfare lineage (public org charts; 2024 PLA reorg reporting).

entities.name: RGB
entities.notes: DPRK Reconnaissance General Bureau. Public UN/US attribution for Lazarus.

edges.instrument: Kaspersky Equation + Shadow Brokers public association
edges.notes: Public technical association, not a criminal conviction of the agency.
